fct_github_daily.content:
name: fct_github_daily
description: 'Metric 4: GitHub activity per UTC day, one row per day per activity. Population: Every (day, activity) row in staging: 1 Oct 2026 onward, only fully ended UTC days.'
model: ref('fct_github_daily')
defaults:
  agg_time_dimension: activity_date
dimensions:
  - name: activity_date
    type: time
    type_params:
      time_granularity: day
    description: UTC day.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
  - name: activity
    type: categorical
    description: prs_opened, prs_merged or commits.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
  - name: weekday_name
    type: categorical
    description: Day of the week.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
  - name: is_release_day
    type: categorical
    description: True on GTA 6's release day (var github_release_day).
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
  - name: days_from_release
    type: categorical
    description: Days after release day (negative before it).
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
measures:
  - name: activity_count
    agg: sum
    expr: activity_count
    description: How many on the day. NULL when unavailable, never zero.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: count
          null_rule: NULL when unavailable, never zero. Never add across activities.
  - name: prior_week_count
    agg: max
    expr: prior_week_count
    description: The same activity on the same weekday a week earlier. NULL when that day was not counted.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: count
          null_rule: NULL when the week-earlier day has no count.
          additivity: non_additive
  - name: wow_pct_change
    agg: max
    expr: wow_pct_change
    description: The day against the same weekday a week earlier, in percent.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: percent
          null_rule: NULL unless both days have a count and the week before is above zero.
          additivity: non_additive
config:
  meta:
    dex:
      population:
        rule: 'Every (day, activity) row in staging: 1 Oct 2026 onward, only fully ended UTC days.'
        parent:
          model: stg_github__daily_counts
          key:
            activity_date: activity_date
            activity: activity
      assumptions:
        - decision: What 'GitHub activity' counts
          chosen: PRs opened, PRs merged, commits (GitHub Search API total_count)
          evidence: request
          detail: 'user: metric 4 is GitHub PRs / commits; docs/metrics.md names the Search API `is:pr created:<day>`'
          column: activity
        - decision: Day boundary
          chosen: UTC day, first to last second
          evidence: contract
          detail: 'config.py: all days in this study are UTC days'
          column: activity_date
        - decision: Week-on-week pairing
          chosen: same activity, same weekday 7 calendar days earlier (date join); NULL when either day is missing
          evidence: request
          detail: 'user, 20 Nov: add the previous Thursdays as context and highlight the drop; the headline compares with the Thursday before the same way'
          column: wow_pct_change

--- for (release day, the weeks before it and the weeks after it).
+-- for (release day, the weeks before it and the weeks after it), with the same weekday a week
+-- earlier beside it (a date join, not a row offset, so a missing day cannot shift the pairing).
 {%- set release_day = var('github_release_day') %}
+with daily as (
+    select * from {{ ref('stg_github__daily_counts') }}
+)
+
 select
-    md5(activity || '|' || cast(activity_date as varchar)) as github_day_key,
-    activity_date,
-    activity,
-    case activity
+    md5(daily.activity || '|' || cast(daily.activity_date as varchar)) as github_day_key,
+    daily.activity_date,
+    daily.activity,
+    case daily.activity
         when 'prs_opened' then 'PRs opened'
         when 'prs_merged' then 'PRs merged'
         when 'commits' then 'Commits'
-        else activity
+        else daily.activity
     end as activity_label,
-    activity_count,
-    is_available,
-    dayname(activity_date) as weekday_name,
-    activity_date = date '{{ release_day }}' as is_release_day,
-    cast(date_diff('day', date '{{ release_day }}', activity_date) as integer)
+    daily.activity_count,
+    daily.is_available,
+    dayname(daily.activity_date) as weekday_name,
+    daily.activity_date = date '{{ release_day }}' as is_release_day,
+    cast(date_diff('day', date '{{ release_day }}', daily.activity_date) as integer)
         as days_from_release,
-    observed_at
-from {{ ref('stg_github__daily_counts') }}
+    daily.observed_at,
+    week_before.activity_count as prior_week_count,
+    case
+        when daily.activity_count is not null and week_before.activity_count > 0
+            then 100 * (daily.activity_count / week_before.activity_count - 1)
+    end as wow_pct_change
+from daily
+left join daily as week_before
+    on daily.activity = week_before.activity
+    and week_before.activity_date = cast(daily.activity_date - 7 as date)
